title: Eternal Carafe of Wine (Or Sometimes Acid)

sources.title: Eternal Carafe of Wine (Or Sometimes Acid)

summary: Reusable carafe with random wine or acid after each Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Wine causes Alcohol for 2 turns and acid causes Caustic Brine for 1 turn. The contents reroll after each Long Rest.
fields.Alcohol: Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
